To evaluate GEC performance, we adopt GLEU to evaluate model performance on the JFLEG dataset. The official tool ERRANT of the BEA19 shared task is used to calculate Precision, Recall, and F 0.5 scores for other datasets. For the CoNLL-2014 dataset, the M 2 evaluation is also adopted as our main evaluation.
